141-3905-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3905-5231.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {R}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

719-3899-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-3899-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Repeat.

Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.

When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

141-2438-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

4284-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Clone
4284-5299-5466.description:
Cast Clone by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Clone into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clone's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Clone's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Clone's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

731-790-5076.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
731-790-5076.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing 1 damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
